name: VolunteerShiftCoordinator
tagline: Volunteer shifts, sign-ups, waitlists and check-in in one Power Apps component – with hours and no-show tracking built in.
description: A complete volunteer scheduling app: opportunities and shifts with capacity and requirements; sign-ups with an automatic, ordered waitlist and promotion; skills checks with coordinator override; double-booking prevention; a check-in kiosk with rounded hours; no-show and late-cancellation tracking with a no-show limit; calendar and roster views; and volunteer hours, fill rate and reliability KPIs. Works in canvas and model-driven apps and on Power Pages.
features: Shift capacity, overbooking and fill rate
Requirements: block, warn or override with reason
Check-in / check-out kiosk with rounded hours
Bulk check-in, check-out, confirm and no-show
Repeat a shift next week with its volunteers
Demo mode with a fictional food bank
